name: sparkles-text
title: Sparkles Text
description: A dynamic text that generates continuous sparkles with smooth transitions, perfect for highlighting text with animated stars.
usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { SparklesText } from '@/components/ui/sparkles-text'
</script>

<template>
  <SparklesText>Magic UI</SparklesText>
</template>

props.name: sparklesCount
props.description: How many sparkles are on the text at once. Sparkles are hidden when the user prefers reduced motion.

props.name: colors
props.description: The two colours sparkles are picked from.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The text to sparkle (rendered inside a `<strong>`).
